name: Eldrazi spawn
description: Swarming decayed creatures with membranous bodies that attack Fort Keff behind a cloud of yellow dust.

timeline.summary: A cloud of yellow dust sweeps over Fort Keff, and the Eldrazi spawn arrive at the gates.
timeline.quote: When the worst had past, Gideon struggled to his feet and saw that enemy was already at the gates.

timeline.summary: The creatures crash into the rampart, arrows prove useless, and Gideon draws his sural and leaps into the fray.
timeline.quote: Then he jumped into the fray.

timeline.summary: Gideon draws all the creatures' attention to himself and whirls his sural until the attackers lie dead and Fort Keff is saved.

pages_say.description: Swarming decayed creatures with membranous bodies that attack Fort Keff behind a cloud of yellow dust.
